rows.note: This is the all-purpose modifier for something relating to a colony.

example.english: Colonial laws still affect life today.
example.traditional: 殖民地嘅法例仲影響緊而家嘅生活。
example.jyutping: zik6 man4 dei6 ge3 faat3 lai6 zung6 jing2 hoeng2 gan2 ji4 gaa1 ge3 saang1 wut6

rows.traditional: 殖民地時期 + 嘅 + N
rows.jyutping: zik6 man4 dei6 si4 kei4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this specifically for something from the period when a place was a colony.

example.english: Buildings from the colonial period are still quite well preserved.
example.traditional: 殖民地時期嘅建築保存得幾好。
example.jyutping: zik6 man4 dei6 si4 kei4 ge3 gin3 zuk1 bou2 cyun4 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.jyutping: zik6 man4 zyu2 ji6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when the thing explicitly reflects or concerns colonialist ideology.

example.english: Colonial ideology still has an influence today.
example.traditional: 殖民主義嘅思想到而家仲有影響。
example.jyutping: zik6 man4 zyu2 ji6 ge3 si1 soeng2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 jau5 jing2 hoeng2
